confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge for July peak season, not checked against live listings. Turkish lira prices are volatile and peak-season rates vary widely, so accommodation anchors (especially 3-star) are the least certain. cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 1.9x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page for 15 October 2026; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort tier (Fethiye, Marmaris, Antalya), with Bodrum's July premium applied. Turkey is transcontinental; Europe is used here because Bodrum's visitor economy and price structure resemble Mediterranean resorts, though Turkey's price level sits well below Western European resorts.
